description: Fetches a public page and scores how quotable its content is for AI engines once it is crawled and indexed. Measures answer-first structure, question headings, lists and tables, FAQ, paragraph and sentence length, statistic and source density, named entities, schema, author, freshness and llms.txt, plus a short crawler-access summary. Use for "will AI cite this page?", "is this article LLM-friendly?" or a GEO check. Tuned for articles and guides.

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the page to check, for example https://example.com/pricing.

name: check_ai_citability
title: Check AI citability of a URL
